call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Google Cloud Doubling (+103% YoY to $30.7B) & TPU Capacity Constraints
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Sundar, Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7B this quarter, which is staggering scale. How much of this growth is driven by TPU systems sales and external training workloads versus core software, and are you currently compute-constrained on TPU availability?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Sundar Pichai stated that Cloud is experiencing broad-based acceleration across infrastructure, foundation model APIs, and enterprise solutions. Demand for custom TPU systems is intense, with major frontier AI labs and Global 2000 enterprises selecting GCP for its full-stack price-performance advantage. While capacity is expanding as rapidly as power and data centers allow, demand continues to outpace supply, which is why Alphabet is actively investing capital into scaling infrastructure.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Search Query Growth at 5-Year High vs. AI Overviews Margin Dynamics
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Sundar, you noted that year-over-year search query growth was the highest in five years. Can you unpack how AI Overviews and multimodal queries are driving that behavior, and what the incremental cost per query looks like now that Gemini is serving answers at scale?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Sundar Pichai explained that AI Overviews have fundamentally expanded the types of questions users ask Google. People are asking more complex, multi-step queries and using multimodal inputs via Lens and Circle to Search. On the unit economics front, the team has driven down the serving cost per Gemini query by over 90% through custom silicon and model optimization, enabling Alphabet to maintain a 31.8% operating margin while serving billions of daily AI interactions.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: CapEx Trajectory ($24B in Q3) & Non-Operating Investment Volatility
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Ruth, CapEx reached $23.95 billion in the third quarter and you guided Q4 to be at or above that level. Can you provide more color on the payback horizon for this spend, and could you clarify the -$8.2 billion other expense that impacted headline GAAP net income?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: President & CIO Ruth Porat explained that over 65% of the CapEx is dedicated to technical infrastructure, specifically servers and networking gear that have immediate, contracted customer backlog in Google Cloud. Regarding the other expense line, Ruth clarified that it was driven primarily by mark-to-market unrealized valuation adjustments on Alphabet's equity and private investment portfolio, which fluctuates quarterly under GAAP accounting rules and has zero impact on operating cash flow ($48.4B).
